label: mid-to-late original-phase / delimiter steps with a specific token-history conjunction (no clean description)
explanation: Sparse feature (0.06% of steps). It fires only in the original phase (t=2..9, peak t=4-5) and at the <DEL> step, never during copy. It is enriched for previous token o/3/x (o 12.6x lift), first token r/1/f/h (up to 8x), and current input n/e/a/v/3/h/<DEL>. Every one of these is a soft tendency, not a requirement. Combining them, the best conjunction reaches only about 0.11 precision and 0.34 recall on dev. Looser versions get about 0.6 recall but under 4% precision. The feature looks like it reads a distributed hidden-state direction built from several earlier tokens, which simple token predicates cannot capture. Activations are fairly uniform (median 0.12, max 0.26); no magnitude modulator was checked.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=r (+5.52), prev_tok=o (+4.98), orig0=1 (+4.81), orig0=f (+4.66), orig0=h (+3.92), prev2_tok=o (+3.43). Lower it: phase=2 (-6.17), orig1=i (-3.17), orig2=i (-2.85), orig1=g (-2.82).
